newsitem.title: USA: McKesson names new CFO, sets restructuring.
newsitem.headline: McKesson names new CFO, sets restructuring.

text.p: McKesson Corp said Richard Hawkins, currently a corporate vice president and controller, was named to the additional position of chief financial officer.
He succeeds Kevin Ferrell, who has resigned.

The company also announced it is reorganizing its Health Care Service segment in an effort better position itself to become "the distributor of choice for pharmacy and health care provider organizations and the leader in comprehensive pharmaceutical management."
It said the restructuring will involve eliminating the position of president of McKesson Drug Co by not replacing James Smith, who resigned eight months ago.
